desc: Formalize the pair-state recurrence and base cases, including paths of length 0 and length 1.
Design the reverse BFS propagation from inner pairs to outer pairs using matching edge labels.
Precompute incoming and outgoing adjacency grouped by label to enumerate valid outer transitions efficiently.
Implement the center-outward BFS over all N^2 pair states, fill the N x N answer matrix with shortest lengths or -1, and run on both samples (both public samples PASSED).
Apply the bitset "unvisited targets" optimization for in/out label masks, keeping inner work to ~N*E big-int operations.
Verify output format and edge cases such as N=1, self-loops, and disconnected vertices.
